System Pricing

CentaurOne's pricing structure is designed to make advanced grain monitoring technology more affordable by keeping the initial equipment investment low and spreading more of the system's cost over an annual AI Monitoring subscription.

This approach allows farmers to invest less money upfront while maintaining access to advanced grain monitoring technology.

As the comparison below demonstrates, even with our annual AI Monitoring subscription, CentaurOne's total cost remains lower every year through Year 10.

Lower Investment. Faster Potential Payback.

Better grain management can create value through reduced spoilage and shrink, more efficient fan operation, and fewer hours spent checking grain. Because CentaurOne requires a smaller initial investment, comparable savings can recover its cost sooner.

Illustrative savings breakdown for one 30,000-bushel bin. The payback chart assumes both CentaurOne and competing systems deliver the same $2,000 in annual operating savings.
